description: Get a Premier Letters API key without the user copying one by hand. Pass the user's email and your name; we email them a link to approve (they can sign up from it if they have no account). Then call check_connection with the returned request_id and poll_secret every 10-30 seconds until it returns the api_key (returned once). Show the returned user_code to the user so they can match it on the approval page. No account or key needed to call this.

agent_name.description: Your name as the user will see it, 1-80 characters: letters, digits, spaces and . , ' & ( ) - _ only (no links), e.g. "Claude".

email.description: The account owner's email address. The approval link is sent here.

name: connect_account
